privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.controllerText: The mosque organization operating this website is responsible for the personal data submitted through it.
privacy.dataText: Personal data is used for stated purposes such as mosque updates and community communication. If you enable push notifications, the browser subscription, language, and prayer reminder timing are stored so notifications can be delivered.
privacy.purposeText: Data is used only for stated purposes such as mosque updates and community communication.
privacy.retentionText: Data is kept only as long as operationally and legally necessary, then deleted or anonymized.
privacy.rightsText: You may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, or information about how your data is processed, subject to applicable legal obligations.
privacy.contactText: Use the contact information on the Mosque Info page for privacy questions.
privacy.reviewNotice: This page is an operational template and should be reviewed by the mosque’s legal or data-protection adviser before public launch.

legal.privacyIntro: This page describes the application's current data behavior. It is not the final legally reviewed privacy notice.
legal.dataSummary: Public content is available without an account. If you create an account or enable notifications, the service processes the email, saved Azkar identifiers, prayer-reminder choices, push subscription details, language, and limited technical delivery data required by those features. For Qibla, your precise location is used on this device to calculate the bearing and magnetic correction; only a coarse location may be sent to display your city. Compass readings remain on the device.
legal.accountDeletion: You can permanently delete your account from the Account page. This removes Saved Azkar and reminder choices and disconnects notification devices from the account. You can disable notifications separately in Settings.
legal.notifications: Browser and Android notification permissions are optional and can be revoked in the application, browser, or device settings. Prayer reminders use the mosque's published schedule.
legal.contactPending: The verified legal controller, privacy contact, retention details, and any required statutory disclosures must be supplied and approved by the mosque before public launch.
legal.reviewRequired: LEGAL CONTENT PENDING — final wording and provider details require mosque and legal review before public launch.
legal.imprintIntro: This route is the technical home for the legally required provider information. Verified provider content has not yet been supplied.
legal.providerPending: CONTENT INPUT PENDING — verified organization name, legal form, authorized representative, register details, and responsible publisher must be provided.
legal.contactDetailsPending: CONTENT INPUT PENDING — verified postal address, email address, telephone number, and any further legally required contact details must be provided.
